title: publish-redactions
description: monitor/publish-redactions.json — the names replaced when a private register is rendered into a public docsite page. Applied on write by bin/taxonomy-web.mjs and bin/taxonomy-render.mjs via lib/publish-redactions.mjs, which validates against THIS schema rather than re-implementing it, so there is one statement of the shape and not two. Keys are matched case-insensitively and longest-first; a key containing whitespace would never match a rendered identifier, so it is refused here rather than silently redacting nothing.

note.description: Why this file exists and what belongs in it. Required: a redaction map with no rationale is one nobody can audit.

map.description: source name -> published replacement. Both sides non-empty: an empty replacement would delete the surrounding sentence's subject and leave prose that reads as though nothing was removed.
